source_of_truth: ouuut-v2 design-lock + live computed styles at 1440px, 2026-10-21. japan.ouuut.com must read as the same publication as ouuut.com.
style: Tokyo Expedition Magazine Editorial / ouuut family. Two themes only: sage (day) and dark (night). Zero structural lines.
theme_boot: localStorage pj-theme wins; otherwise sage 06:00-17:59, dark otherwise. No mono.

typography.wordmark: Outfit 800 33px; japan / .com stay var(--ink), only ouuut (five letters) and the second dot take the six chapter colours in order 青磁→山吹→朱→藍→苔→紫; the three phrase layers stay ink (var(--ink), black on paper / white on charcoal)
typography.serif: Instrument Serif 400 / Noto Serif JP 700 / Noto Serif SC 700
typography.sans: Geist 400-500 / Noto Sans JP 500 / Noto Sans SC 500

home.band: Six plates, three across, two rows; grid gap 16px. Two columns ≤1199px, one column ≤1000px (horizontal card), vertical card ≤640px.
home.plate_box: aspect-ratio 1000/332 at ≥1001px (340 before the block under the band needed the fold); 641-1000px the card turns horizontal and that breakpoint's own rule wins — height:100% with min-height 188px, no aspect-ratio applies there; at ≤640px the card turns vertical and it is 1000/680 again (measured 0.6801 at 390px). Every plate is a build-time SVG at viewBox 1000×760, centred, never stretched (preserveAspectRatio meet). The wide box ratio is deliberate: it letterboxes the plates to 42-46% of the box width (~110-120px of gutter per side) at ≥1200px, which is the price of six plates inside one screen, not an accident. The shipped labels inside those plates (.micro/.legend 22px, .ward 24px user units) render at 3.9-4.4px there, as they already did at 4-7px before this round.
home.preview_plates: weather and news have no feed yet: the foot reads「予告」/「预告」/「Soon」without the 開く arrow, the card is a div rather than an a, and hover neither lifts nor tints it.
home.h1: The selected A statement follows the C provenance panel, rather than repeating the old band-adjacent title. ZH: 「六种尺度看日本。」with only「六种尺度」inside em, coloured var(--accent). JA: 「日本を、六つの尺度で見る。」with only「六つの尺度」highlighted. EN: 「Japan through six scales.」with only「six scales」highlighted. All three use white-space:nowrap and px+vw sizing, with language-specific sizes ≤640px; no rem-based growth. Desktop sizes: EN clamp(38px,5.3vw,78px), JA/ZH clamp(38px,5vw,72px); ≤640px: EN clamp(22px,6.4vw,38px), JA clamp(20px,6.7vw,34px), ZH clamp(24px,8.2vw,44px). The global h1 !important font policy is overridden only for .hp-statement h1 and the C heading, never for cards.
home.closing: Selected C+A, not a fifth option. DOM order is .hp-band → .hp-provenance → .hp-statement → .hp-foot. C has a surface panel with PRIMARY SOURCES / STATIC BUILD, method title and lede; a native details element is open by default, works without JavaScript, and contains four source links plus counting rules. The provenance sources are two columns on wide desktop, one column ≤1000px. Housing copy explicitly distinguishes 26,416 Tokyo-wide transactions from 21,848 in the 23 wards. A is the single large closing statement, followed inside the same section by a borderless author signature: 中本蔡 / NAKAMOTO SAI, a one-sentence public bio, ouuut.com labelled as independent projects, saaaai.com neutrally as the main site (its live title is a studio/company page, so do not call it a personal homepage), sai@saaaai.com and X @saaaaicom. No age, visa, family or other private biography. The author block is two columns on desktop and one column ≤1000px. The compact footer contains only the brand and CC BY 4.0 / statically generated / build date, with no duplicate chapter navigation or tagline. Old .hp-scales / .hp-method structures and their translation keys are removed. The four-option lab is retired to F:/archive/20261025-ca-hybrid-panout/closing-options; the production source is the only implementation.
home.masthead_cycle: The masthead wordmark is an accessible link named japan.ouuut.com whose visual layer alternates every twelve seconds: the domain takes about 1.16s to appear glyph by glyph, holds fully visible for about 3s, and fades; then a localized phrase appears, holds for about 3s, and fades before returning to the domain. The phrase is a separate logo per UI language: JA 六つの尺度で日本を見る, ZH 六种尺度看日本, EN Six scales of Japan. JA/ZH use weight 250, matching the .hp-verb「抬头看」reference; EN uses the serif at weight 400, matching its .hp-verb. Only the active language layer is displayed; all are aria-hidden inside a stage whose width is reserved by the static domain, so the tools never move. CSS only, no animation library. prefers-reduced-motion and no-JS both show the static domain with no animation. The footer wordmark remains static.
home.measured_wordmark_2026_10_25: Localized 12000ms cycle measured at the locked >0.99 visual threshold with 50ms samples: domain fully visible 1150–4100ms (3.00s); corrected JA phrase 六つの尺度で日本を見る (11 glyphs) 7100–10450ms (3.40s); ZH 7050–10450ms (3.45s); EN 7250–10450ms (3.25s); no domain/phrase overlap; all durations 12000ms. Supplementary exact-opacity-1 samples are JA 7200–10400ms, ZH 7150–10400ms, EN 7400–10400ms. Exactly one localized layer is visible per language. Nine 320/390/1440 × JA/ZH/EN sweeps passed with zero overflow; JA fits at 237.03/172.33/129.33px and weights remain 250/250/400. Hidden layers keep animating via visibility, so live switches measured 0ms phase drift and no overlap. Reduced-motion and no-JS keep the static domain. Current report: .review/japanese-logo-correction/final-report.json; prior reports are historical. Prior author checks remain in .review/author-wordmark/report.json: sage contrast minimum 5.3:1, dark minimum 6.74:1; ouuut.com, saaaai.com and x.com/saaaaicom returned 200.
home.measured_2026_10_25: Prior card-band measurements are retained: six plates at 1440×900 end at 743–749px across JA/EN/ZH and root font 16/20px; 1920×945 ends at 743–754px. 1024px has two card columns, ≤1000px one column. The selected closing follows below the band; it is not intended to fit the first screen. New closing measurements are recorded in the current verification report, not inferred from the retired preview. The former 768px EN language-control clipping and ≤375px burger clipping are corrected in app.css: compact tablet gaps, unshrunk brand at fitted sizes, 44px burger, full brand at 320–390px.
home.removed_2026_10_25: the cover eyebrow line「JAPAN.OUUUT.COM · 2000—2026」(key cover.kicker) is gone from the cover.

notes: Homepage runs six prod-style plates, three across and two down, in this order: weather, quake, crime, cabinet, housing, news. The four chapter plates are links; the weather and news plates are previews (no live feed), so they carry「予告」instead of「開く」and are not links.
Charts use one signal hue per theme; no rainbow categorical palette.
Motion: grain, scroll progress, header scrolled, .rv reveal, theme view-transition. No custom cursor/particles.
